title: Omotik language — Grokipedia
text: January 3, 2026 - Omotik is classified as a Southern Nilotic language within the Nilotic branch of the Nilo-Saharan language family.[1] This placement is supported by comparative linguistic analysis in Rottland's comprehensive study of Southern Nilotic languages, which groups Omotik with related varieties such as Datooga based on shared morphological and lexical features.
